attempts.cause: The first invocation lacked the owned Kind provider environment, so read-only cluster inventory failed.
Podman returned the Kind node image ID as bare 64-character hex while inventory used the same digest with a sha256: prefix. Commit 7c3eb74 normalized the two representations by validated digest.

sourceArtifactHandling: The three original runner reports, three original stdout logs, and independent cleanup observation are included byte-for-byte and indexed in SHA256SUMS. The owner inventory and kubeconfig are excluded.
